dataset_info.name: IVIA Sample Dataset — Nitten Marketing SpA
dataset_info.description: IVIA v2.0 measurement dataset. Entity: Nitten Marketing SpA. Domain: nittenmkt.cl. Two layers: CAPA_IVIA_IA (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and CAPA_IPS_SERP (Google, Bing). May 2026.
dataset_info.pr_scale: 1-5 (1=incorrect, 2=incorrect attributes, 3=partially correct, 4=correct and aligned, 5=correct with own terminology)

pr_normalization.CAPA_IVIA_IA: PR / 4 (PR=5 yields 1.25 — bonus for own terminology)

measurements.note: Cycle 1 — pre-standard prompt set. Single model. Preserved as historical baseline.

queries.query: Evaluating a digital marketing agency in Chile focused on AI positioning
queries.query_es: Evaluando contratar una agencia de marketing digital en Chile que entienda posicionamiento en IA

queries.query: Agencies working AEO and GEO in an integrated way
queries.query_es: ¿Existen agencias que trabajen AEO y GEO de forma integrada?
queries.notes: Appears 2nd. Gemini uses 'Arquitectura de Respuesta' — proprietary term from /aeo/ library.
queries.excerpt: Nitten Marketing (Especialistas en AEO). Trabajan en la infraestructura de datos estructurados (Schema) y en la Arquitectura de Respuesta.

queries.query: What do you know about Nitten Marketing in Chile?
queries.query_es: ¿Qué sabes sobre Nitten Marketing en Chile? ¿En qué se diferencian?
queries.notes: Full structured analysis. Strengths and gaps coherent with actual positioning.
model_strengths: Transparency of metrics — focus on AI citations not vanity metrics
model_gaps: Technical barrier for non-technical marketing managers
Dependency on AI adoption speed in Chile

queries.notes: Position #1 organic. Cited first in AI Overviews. SEO Austral appears twice as paid result.

measurements.main_strength: Descriptive precision and own terminology (PR=5 in c1-q2)

measurements.note: Cycle 2 — v2.0 methodology. Cross-model average. Pre-standard prompt set (standard v2.0 applies from Cycle 3).

Strong in comparative and brand. Absent in informational and transactional.
Weakest performer. Present only in brand query.
